title: FAQ beside its heading
description: Questions visitors ask, answered, at wide width: the section heading and an optional line of intro in a column beside three questions. On a phone the questions stack under the heading. Each question opens to show its answer, with no script, and the first ships open.

Heading.purpose: The section's h2: what the questions are about, in a few words.

Intro.purpose: One line on what the questions cover. Leave it out when the heading says enough.

Question 1.purpose: One question a visitor asks, in their own words, ending in a question mark. To drop a question, omit this label: its answer goes with it.

Question 1 answer.purpose: One short paragraph that answers the question plainly. A fact in it, such as a price, a time, an area or a licence, comes from the site owner or from Site Data, never from you.

children.text: Short answers to what people ask before they get in touch.
What areas do you work in?
Say which towns or areas you cover, and what someone just outside them can do.
Do you charge for a quote?
Say whether a quote or a first visit costs anything, and how to ask for one.
How soon can you come out?
Say how soon you can usually book a visit, and how to reach you when it cannot wait.
